description: Search the published objects of the Stockholm Archipelago Trail: trail sections (stages), the trail itself, ferry piers, ferry vessels, reviewed public reports and points of interest (lodging, food, shops, nature). Returns matching objects with their permanent sat-identifiers. Use this when the user names or describes a place, stage, pier, vessel or POI category and you need to find its identifier before calling another tool. Do not use for general Sweden/Stockholm travel, gear or weather questions — those are outside this dataset.

query.description: Free-text search, e.g. an island name ("Grinda"), a pier, a vessel or a POI category.

name: search

id.description: Object id — pass to fetch or show_section_map.
